name: Base-100 Sum of Squares Identity
description: Replaced the explicit "every digit is 0 or 1" condition with the mathematically equivalent condition "the sum of the squares of its digits is exactly equal to the sum of its digits". Since digits are non-negative integers, this equality holds if and only if every digit is exactly 0 or 1. This preserves the exact Independent Set logic and avoids the drift of previous attempts (by keeping the exact same V_i and base-100 sum), but disguises the condition as a digit-property puzzle, breaking surface-level pattern matching.
